name: pbt-ping
description: PBT Ping — internal health status page

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix-colors cyan,magenta --names web,api "corepack pnpm run dev:web" "corepack pnpm run dev:api"
scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter=@pbt-ping/api run build && corepack pnpm --filter=@pbt-ping/web run build
scripts.lint: corepack pnpm --filter=@pbt-ping/web run lint && corepack pnpm --filter=@pbt-ping/api run lint
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter=@pbt-ping/web exec tsc --noEmit && corepack pnpm --filter=@pbt-ping/api exec tsc --noEmit
